name: timeline
need: Show the history of a record, an activity feed or comments, on a rail grouped by day

--ds-timeline-indent.description: how far `.ds-timeline` entries sit from the start edge (the rail and its markers live in it), 4px per size step

--ds-timeline-padding.description: an entry's block padding, 2px per density step

--ds-timeline-dot-size.description: the dot of a timeline entry (2px per size step)

--ds-timeline-dot-color.description: the dot of a timeline entry (2px per size step)

--ds-timeline-muted-color.description: the ring of a `.ds-timeline__item--muted` entry, around its dot or its marker

--ds-timeline-line-width.description: the rail (and the width of a muted ring)

--ds-timeline-line-color.description: the rail (and the width of a muted ring)

--ds-timeline-marker-size.description: the disc of `.ds-timeline__marker`, 4px per size step; the rail runs through its centre

--ds-timeline-head-line.description: the head line of an entry, on which its dot is centred (the height of a status chip), 4px per size step above md

--ds-timeline-comment-bg.description: the box of a `.ds-timeline__item--comment` entry's text

--ds-timeline-comment-radius.description: the box of a `.ds-timeline__item--comment` entry's text (times `--ds-shape`)
